entries.text: Others have tried. We never heard from them again.
entries.source_text: Others have tried. We never heard from them again.

entries.text: Hell, you've almost talked me out of even wanting to join#the Brotherhood.
entries.source_text:
Hell, you've almost talked me out of even wanting to join
#the Brotherhood.

entries.text: 大部分上层居民认为那儿仅仅是一个充满辐射的大坑，因此才称它为闪光之地，有些人甚至称它为火辣的地区。我们兄弟会的人才知道真相，通过古老的记录可知这个地方是我们所有技术知识的源泉，天知道那儿还有什么！
entries.source_text: 大部分上层居民认为那儿仅仅是一个充满辐射的大坑，因此才称它为闪光之地，有些人甚至称它为火辣的地区。我们兄弟会的人才知道真相，通过古老的记录可知这个地方是我们所有技术知识的源泉，天知道那儿还有什么！

entries.text: 我得把这个弄明白……
entries.source_text: 我得把这个弄明白……

entries.text: 有些人曾去尝试过，可我们以后再也没见过他们。
entries.source_text: 有些人曾去尝试过，可我们以后再也没见过他们。

entries.text: 该死，你们到底是兄弟会还是整人会？刚才你还想说服我加入你们。
entries.source_text: 该死，你们到底是兄弟会还是整人会？刚才你还想说服我加入你们。

entries.text: They were weak. I'll be seen' you around.
entries.source_text: They were weak. I'll be seen' you around.

entries.text: What should I watch for when I go down there.
entries.source_text: What should I watch for when I go down there.

entries.text: The Glow and the Ancient Order are one in the same.
entries.source_text: The Glow and the Ancient Order are one in the same.

entries.text: What is the Glow?
entries.source_text: What is the Glow?

entries.text: 他们很差劲，我们会再见面的。
entries.source_text: 他们很差劲，我们会再见面的。

entries.text: 当我下去的时候我该注意些什么？
entries.source_text: 当我下去的时候我该注意些什么？

entries.text: 闪光之地和古老的建筑是一回事。
entries.source_text: 闪光之地和古老的建筑是一回事。

entries.text: 闪光之地是什么？
entries.source_text: 闪光之地是什么？

entries.text: Don't get me wrong the Brotherhood is a great place to join.#It's by far the safest place to live in the wastes. No place else#will you find better weapons and armor. We serve technology and#technology serves us.
entries.source_text:
Don't get me wrong the Brotherhood is a great place to join.
#It's by far the safest place to live in the wastes. No place else
#will you find better weapons and armor. We serve technology and
#technology serves us.

entries.text: Sounds good, I'll be going on my way.
entries.source_text: Sounds good, I'll be going on my way.

entries.text: What can you tell me about the Glow.
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about the Glow.

entries.text: It doesn't sound like it is worth the trouble.
entries.source_text: It doesn't sound like it is worth the trouble.

entries.text: What?...
entries.source_text: What?...

entries.text: 别误会我的意思，兄弟会是一个值得加入的伟大的地方，到目前为止它是废土上最安全的居住之地，你不会在其它地方找到比这儿更好的武器和装甲，我们服务于科技，而科技也服务于我们。
entries.source_text: 别误会我的意思，兄弟会是一个值得加入的伟大的地方，到目前为止它是废土上最安全的居住之地，你不会在其它地方找到比这儿更好的武器和装甲，我们服务于科技，而科技也服务于我们。

entries.text: 听起来不错，我马上就去。
entries.source_text: 听起来不错，我马上就去。

entries.text: 关于闪光之地你能告诉我些什么。
entries.source_text: 关于闪光之地你能告诉我些什么。

entries.text: 看起来不值得冒这个险。
entries.source_text: 看起来不值得冒这个险。

entries.text: 什么？……
entries.source_text: 什么？……

entries.text: Why does the Ancient Order have two names?
entries.source_text: Why does the Ancient Order have two names?

entries.text: Where is the Ancient Order, and the dangers are...?
entries.source_text: Where is the Ancient Order, and the dangers are...?

entries.text: Can I ask you a few questions?
entries.source_text: Can I ask you a few questions?

entries.text: Most topsiders think that it is just a big Radioactive hole.#Thus the name became the Glow or some even call it the Hot Spot.#We in the Brotherhood know the truth. According to the ancient#writings this place was the source of all our technology. And who#knows what may still be there.
entries.source_text:
Most topsiders think that it is just a big Radioactive hole.
#Thus the name became the Glow or some even call it the Hot Spot.
#We in the Brotherhood know the truth. According to the ancient
#writings this place was the source of all our technology. And who
#knows what may still be there.

entries.text: Got another question for you.
entries.source_text: Got another question for you.

entries.text: 为什么古老的建筑有两个名字？
entries.source_text: 为什么古老的建筑有两个名字？

entries.text: 古老的建筑在哪儿？危险是……？
entries.source_text: 古老的建筑在哪儿？危险是……？

entries.text: 我能问你些问题吗？
entries.source_text: 我能问你些问题吗？

entries.text: 我还有个问题问你。
entries.source_text: 我还有个问题问你。

entries.text: Can I help you?
entries.source_text: Can I help you?

entries.text: Nevermind. Bye.
entries.source_text: Nevermind. Bye.

entries.text: Sure ask away.
entries.source_text: Sure ask away.

entries.text: Hello
entries.source_text: Hello

entries.text: Yes, Rutger came here personally not too long ago, and that's#not like him. He was trying to find out what had been happening to#his caravans. I've no idea what it could have been. A few others#say they saw something over near the hub, but it disappeared before#they could get close enough. It's all very unnerving, I hope it's#resolved soon.
entries.source_text:
Yes, Rutger came here personally not too long ago, and that's
#not like him. He was trying to find out what had been happening to
#his caravans. I've no idea what it could have been. A few others
#say they saw something over near the hub, but it disappeared before
#they could get close enough. It's all very unnerving, I hope it's
#resolved soon.

entries.text: 要我帮忙吗？
entries.source_text: 要我帮忙吗？

entries.text: 没什么，再见。
entries.source_text: 没什么，再见。

entries.text: 随便问吧。
entries.source_text: 随便问吧。

entries.text: 你好。
entries.source_text: 你好。

entries.text: 是的，不久前罗格尔亲自来到这儿，这可不像他的作风！他想查出他的商队究竟发生了什么事情。我不知道究竟是什么回事，有几个家伙说他们在哈勃城附近看见一些东西，但是在他们靠近之前就消失了。这一切都非同寻常，我希望这个疑团能很快解开。
entries.source_text: 是的，不久前罗格尔亲自来到这儿，这可不像他的作风！他想查出他的商队究竟发生了什么事情。我不知道究竟是什么回事，有几个家伙说他们在哈勃城附近看见一些东西，但是在他们靠近之前就消失了。这一切都非同寻常，我希望这个疑团能很快解开。

entries.text: I heard you make animal sacrifices! Maybe you take these#caravans for your dark rituals!
entries.source_text:
I heard you make animal sacrifices! Maybe you take these
#caravans for your dark rituals!

entries.text: Any suspicions?
entries.source_text: Any suspicions?

entries.text: Well, if you see anything let me know. I'd like to get to the#bottom of this soon myself.
entries.source_text:
Well, if you see anything let me know. I'd like to get to the
#bottom of this soon myself.

entries.text: Not really, but I suspect it's foul play... but then again,#there are a lot of strange and dangerous creatures out there in the#wastelands. It could simply be some creature, or more likely a#herd or band of them. I hope that helps. Good day.
entries.source_text:
Not really, but I suspect it's foul play... but then again,
#there are a lot of strange and dangerous creatures out there in the
#wastelands. It could simply be some creature, or more likely a
#herd or band of them. I hope that helps. Good day.

entries.text: 我听说你们用动物来献祭！也许你把商队抓来做黑暗的仪式了。
entries.source_text: 我听说你们用动物来献祭！也许你把商队抓来做黑暗的仪式了。

entries.text: 有什么疑点吗？
entries.source_text: 有什么疑点吗？

entries.text: 那么，如果你知道什么请告诉我，我不久就要独自下到它的底部去了。
entries.source_text: 那么，如果你知道什么请告诉我，我不久就要独自下到它的底部去了。

entries.text: 其实不是这样，我猜这是不公平的竞赛……但是再一次地，废土上有很多陌生并且危险的生物，可能仅仅是一些生物，或者是牧群，或是二者的结合。我希望这有些用，祝你愉快！
